description:
Get the measured design guide for a product: observed font families, color palette, type scale,
layout patterns, spacing values, and component observations. Marketing site and product UI
are measured separately.

Use this when you want to match a competitor's design system, understand their visual language,
or borrow their typography and color choices for your own project.

context.description: Which surface to return. Omit for both.

productId.description: Product id from listProducts, e.g. linear, stripe or airbnb.

name: get_design
title: Get a product's design guide
